extracted_concepts.name: Power Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If f(x) = x^n where n is a real number, then f'(x) = nx^(n-1)

extracted_concepts.name: Constant Multiple Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If c is a constant and f(x) is differentiable, then d/dx[cf(x)] = cf'(x)

extracted_concepts.name: Sum Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: d/dx[f(x) + g(x)] = f'(x) + g'(x)

extracted_concepts.name: Difference Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: d/dx[f(x) - g(x)] = f'(x) - g'(x)

extracted_concepts.name: Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The derivative as a rate of change; f'(x) measures instantaneous change

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The process of computing derivatives; inverse operation of antidifferentiation

extracted_concepts.name: Polynomial
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Functions differentiated using the Power Rule and related rules

extracted_concepts.name: Exponential Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: d/dx(a^x) = a^x · ln a

extracted_concepts.name: Natural Exponential Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: d/dx(e^x) = e^x; the exponential function is its own derivative

extracted_concepts.name: The Number e
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The unique number for which lim_{h→0} (e^h - 1)/h = 1

extracted_concepts.name: Natural Logarithm
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: ln a appears in the derivative formula d/dx(a^x) = a^x · ln a

extracted_concepts.name: Limit
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Used to define the number e: lim_{h→0} (e^h - 1)/h = 1

extracted_concepts.name: Velocity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: v(t) = s'(t); derivative of position

extracted_concepts.name: Acceleration
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: a(t) = v'(t) = s''(t); derivative of velocity

extracted_concepts.name: Position Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: s(t); its derivative gives velocity

extracted_concepts.name: Second Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: s''(t); derivative of the derivative, giving acceleration from position

extracted_concepts.name: Marginal Cost
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: MC = C'(x); derivative of the cost function in economics

extracted_concepts.name: Cost Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: C(x); its derivative is the marginal cost

extracted_concepts.name: Rate of Change
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The derivative interpreted as a rate of change connecting to physics, biology, economics

extracted_concepts.name: Tangent Line Approximation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Uses the derivative to estimate function values near a known point

extracted_concepts.name: Antidifferentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The inverse operation of differentiation

extracted_concepts.name: Integration
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Antidifferentiation; connected to differentiation by the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus

extracted_concepts.name: Fundamental Theorem of Calculus
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Connects differentiation and integration (antidifferentiation)

extracted_concepts.name: Real Exponent
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The Power Rule extends to any real exponent, e.g. 1/2, -3, π

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiability
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Requirement that f and g be differentiable for the rules to apply
